skeleton._comment: Every hub option banks chatted_with_grimalkin, the met counter his inn-guest row needs. The repo's usual producer is a talk_pool on the entity, but this Grimalkin carries a conversation and NO talk_pool, and giving him one would change what his first interact of every waking does on a shipped entity -- so the bank rides the conversation, appended LAST in each effects array so no existing effect's event order moves. All four options carry it; effects never change the rendered option list, so every index-driven script over this hub is untouched.
